summary: Learn SharePoint metadata, permissions, retention, and migration planning. Build practical governance artefacts for your Microsoft 365 environment. Enquire toda
lede: SharePoint information architecture organizes business content so people can find it while access and records are managed. For records managers, knowledge managers, site owners, and IT-business systems coordinators, the training addresses practical design decisions across SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365. Participants draft content-type and metadata models, review permissions and retention-label choices, and plan version control, migration, and search improvements, with Purview and Copilot discovery covered at an operational overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape document structures, access rules, records handling, or Microsoft 365 collaboration. It suits practitioners who need to translate governance requirements into usable SharePoint designs.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with Microsoft 365 or SharePoint sites is recommended. No coding is required. Exercises use governance scenarios and planning artefacts rather than a supplied live tenant; access to Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, or Microsoft Purview is not included. Product capabilities depend on the organization’s Microsoft 365 licensing and configuration.
